finding: Geometric mean and geometric SD are reported on the log scale
evidence_or_action: Shared numeric-statistics.R computes exp(mean(log(x))) and exp(sd(log(x))) without internal rounding.

finding: Yule's V and Wilson's e compute the wrong values
evidence_or_action: Yule’s V uses the marginal square root; Wilson’s e uses unordered pair counts without doubling.

finding: The ordinal "inner range" is always the full range
evidence_or_action: Ordinal coverage uses NPerc/100 rather than length(NPerc). Follow-up fixes the separate inner-range column metadata repetition count.

finding: Ordinal Data analysis summarises factor codes, not the data's values
evidence_or_action: Ordinal numerical operations and plots use jmvcore::toNumeric instead of factor level codes.

finding: The Wilcoxon signed-rank analysis computes several statistics as if the samples were independent
evidence_or_action: Paired HL; corrected signed-rank denominator and one-sided tails; selected-pair CIs, requested confidence width and variable labels. Paired z was already in 0.1.2.

finding: Mann-Whitney: group 2's average rank and the tie-corrected z are wrong
evidence_or_action: Group 2 divides by n2; shared z helper uses N+1 and the tie correction. Rank sums safely handle empty groups.

finding: Discrete Distributions: the hypergeometric is mislabelled and its plots can crash
evidence_or_action: Hypergeometric label; shared validated finite plot support; corrected validation variable. Quantile-based infinite-support bounds avoid the old negative-binomial SD error.

finding: Normality Tests always runs all seven tests, so an unrequested test can fail the whole analysis
evidence_or_action: Only selected tests execute; errors are per-cell footnotes; missing/constant values are checked; K–S inference caveat.

finding: Grouped ECDF plot pairs values with the wrong groups
evidence_or_action: Shared ECDF frame retains group pairing, excludes incomplete rows, standardises per group and facets by group.

finding: Two plots call ggplot2 functions without the namespace and fail
status: ALREADY PRESENT IN 0.1.2 — runtime verification pending
evidence_or_action: Both namespace fixes already existed in the uploaded 0.1.2 source; retained.

finding: boot is used but not declared
evidence_or_action: boot declared; reproducible bootstrap with RNG restoration; computation gated by displayed CIs/plots. Q–Q plotting is internal; qqplotr/qqconf are not imported.

finding: The version is below the library's minimum
evidence_or_action: DESCRIPTION, manifest and analysis definitions use 1.0.0; generated R headers require jmvtools regeneration.

finding: Table visibility rules use names that aren't options
evidence_or_action: Bivariate visibility expressions name every contributing real option.

finding: Variable names with spaces break the bivariate plots
evidence_or_action: aes_string replaced with data-mask mappings; pasted table formulas replaced with table() and explicit dimension names.

finding: Inputs that crash an analysis with an R error instead of a message
evidence_or_action: Empty summaries, constant histogram widths, mixed one-level effects, empty contingency tables, percentile bounds and distribution parameter guards.

finding: A "plots only" type check stops the whole analysis
evidence_or_action: Plot preparation skips unsupported types rather than stopping tables; ordinal selectors permit factors and bivariate ordinal validation rejects unordered inputs clearly.

finding: Table rows and plot images are created in .run() when the structure is known earlier
evidence_or_action: Normality plots initialize once; group-dependent rows are populated from full data; unique variable/group keys; distribution rows moved to initialization; duplicate mixed plot initialization removed.

finding: clearWith entries that name no option
evidence_or_action: Result clearWith keys corrected; CI/plot dependencies and group changes recorded.

finding: Spelling, symbols and statistic names
evidence_or_action: Corrected names, symbols, percentiles and the names of squared Kendall tau, quartile dispersion and Kruskal–Wallis effect size.

finding: Casing is inconsistent across panels and results
evidence_or_action: Sentence casing normalized for cited controls and columns; X/Y boxes use variable labels; optional grouping label corrected.

finding: Box-plot fence controls are greyed out when they still have an effect
evidence_or_action: Fence controls and CI width/method controls include plot activation.

finding: Wilcoxon Descriptives spreads categories across identically titled columns
evidence_or_action: Three rank-descriptive rows per pair with numeric missing tied-rank cells.

finding: Raw data is stored in plot state, sometimes twice
evidence_or_action: Histogram/box plots store descriptors and declare requiresData; ordinal frequency bars keep aggregate state.

finding: NAMESPACE imports the whole of jmvcore, and two Imports are unused
evidence_or_action: Selective jmvcore translation import; qualified remaining calls; unused hrbrthemes/magrittr removed; data-mask pronoun imported from rlang.

finding: No citations for the methods and packages doing the work
evidence_or_action: Package and method references added and connected in result YAML. Rendering/compilation remains to verify.

finding: Very long functions
evidence_or_action: Shared numeric/Q–Q/distribution/rank/CI/error helpers reduce duplication. Further per-table decomposition of remaining long routines is pending. Follow-up extracts rank calculations, CI assembly, test dispatch, percentage parsing and repeated rank-result population; analysis-specific routines remain.

finding: Deprecated ggplot2 usage
evidence_or_action: Active aes_string, fun.y and guides(fill=FALSE) removed; line geom widths use linewidth; density mappings use after_stat.

finding: Option descriptions contradict their defaults
evidence_or_action: Bool descriptions updated to their actual defaults; stray embedded mode declaration removed; grouping descriptions corrected.

finding: No unit tests
evidence_or_action: Previous 26-block candidate passed; new helpers/layout/table refactor require a new runtime run.
